response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced fullstack engineer (15+ years, well beyond the 6+ requirement) with directly relevant recent work in TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, and AWS at Optilyz and re:cinq, plus current hands-on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling experience that maps precisely to the 'AI agent development' requirement. He demonstrates strong engineering craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, authored test frameworks) and a CS degree. Minor gaps exist around the named stack specifics (Nest.js, Vitest, Kotlin, PostgreSQL), but these are easily bridged given his multi-language breadth and testing depth. Worth interviewing, with technical probing on Nest.js/Kotlin and modern frontend depth.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js/React fullstack experience across multiple companies
Hands-on AI-agent and MCP tooling work matching a hard-to-find requirement
Strong testing and engineering-craft culture (TDD, CI/CD, built test frameworks, teaches workshops)
concerns: No explicit Nest.js, Vitest, or Kotlin experience listed
Significant time invested in DLang, a niche stack with limited transfer to the target team
Relational DB depth (PostgreSQL) is thin; experience skews MongoDB/MySQL

key_factors.factor: Missing named stack items (Nest.js, Vitest, Kotlin)
